root_idea.summary: The attested lexical orientation is mustard, especially the mustard seed or grain.
root_idea.development: The supplied evidence does not establish a broader root-level semantic development beyond this plant-name.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic nominal is presented under the normalized dictionary citation form خَرْدَل.

senses.definition: Mustard seed; mustard, specifically the grain of the mustard plant.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences refer to the mustard seed or grain; renderings such as “mustard” and “mustard seed” represent the same lexical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mustard used as a medicinal and practical substance: heating, emollient, drawing, phlegmagogue, lenitive, and digestive; used in liniments and remedies, with its juice or oil applied for earache, its powder for toothache, and its smoke used to repel serpents and other harmful reptiles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are broader Classical Arabic properties and applications of mustard, not separate Quranic senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular plant in Egypt known as حَشِيشَةُ السُّلْطَانِ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specific regional plant designation within the broader mustard entry.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit supplies the mustard-seed identification and distinct medicinal and practical applications.
The unit identifies a specific Egyptian plant designation.

cautions: The medicinal and practical properties recorded in Classical Arabic are not asserted as additional Quranic meanings.
